# `AgentFrame` JSON Schema

Status: current

<!-- generated by docs/reference/generate.py; do not edit -->

[`docs/design/types.md`](../../design/types.md).

        }

          ]

    "AssignmentPayload": {
      "description": "The durable, token-free payload the home stores and sends with `AssignRun`.\n\nIt carries environment and secret **names** only, a project-relative [`PathRef`],\nthe base commit, the remote name, the project's expected remote URL, the epoch, an\noptional deadline and the per-run spool cap. It **never** contains a lease token, a\nsecret value or an absolute local path. The lease token travels only in\n[`crate::agent::AgentFrame::AssignRun`].",
      "properties": {
        "assignment_id": {
          "description": "Durable assignment id.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "base_commit": {
          "description": "Base commit the run starts from.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "cwd_ref": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/PathRef",
          "description": "Project-relative working directory; the agent resolves it locally."
        },

          "anyOf": [
            {
              "$ref": "#/$defs/Timestamp"
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ],
          "description": "Deadline after which the home fences the run, when any."
        },
        "env_names": {
          "description": "Environment variable names to resolve on the node; never values.",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "epoch": {
          "description": "Assignment epoch; a higher epoch supersedes a lower one.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "executor": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/Executor",
          "description": "Executor to start."
        },
        "job": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/JobId",
          "description": "Job the run belongs to."
        },
        "project": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/ProjectName",
          "description": "Project the run works in."
        },
        "prompt": {
          "description": "Home-seeded prompt.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "purpose": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/RunPurpose",
          "description": "Why the run starts."
        },
        "remote": {
          "description": "Git remote name on the node.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "remote_url": {
          "description": "The home project's remote URL, compared with credentials stripped.\n\nThe agent compares its push URL (not the fetch URL) with this value and refuses a\nmismatch as `remote_mismatch`. The home strips URL userinfo before storing it, and the\nagent never logs the raw value. A bundle assignment carries an empty value: it needs\nno git credential and must not push.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "result_transport": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/ResultTransport",
          "default": "push",
          "description": "How the run returns its result: `push` or `bundle`.\n\nThe assignment's value wins for the whole run; the agent and the home never fall\nback to the other transport. An older literal without this field parses as `push`."
        },
        "run_id": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/RunId",
          "description": "Run id assigned by the home."
        },
        "secret_names": {
          "description": "Secret names to resolve on the node; never values.",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/SecretName"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "session_id": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/SessionId",
          "description": "Session the run writes to."
        },
        "spool_cap_bytes": {
          "description": "Per-run spool cap in bytes.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "assignment_id",

    "OrchestratorCommand": {
      "description": "One home -> agent orchestrator command.\n\nThe home correlates the agent's [`OrchestratorResult`] by `request_id`; the agent\nmaterializes the local copy and starts, stops or resumes the app. The payload never\ncarries a port, a password, a pairing link, an absolute local path or a secret value.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "description": "Create the local record and start the app host.",
          "properties": {
            "action": {
              "const": "start",
              "type": "string"
            },
            "app": {
              "$ref": "#/$defs/OrchestratorApp",
              "description": "App to run."
            },
            "name": {
              "description": "Orchestrator name.",
              "type": "string"
            },
            "project": {
              "anyOf": [
                {
                  "$ref": "#/$defs/ProjectName"
                },
                {
                  "type": "null"
                }
              ],
              "description": "Project to bind, when any."
            },
            "request_id": {
              "description": "Home-assigned correlation id.",
              "type": "string"
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "action",
            "request_id",
            "name",
            "app"
          ],
          "type": "object"
        },
        {
          "description": "Stop the app host and release its surface.",
          "properties": {
            "action": {
              "const": "stop",
              "type": "string"
            },
            "name": {
              "description": "Orchestrator name.",
              "type": "string"
            },
            "request_id": {
              "description": "Home-assigned correlation id.",
              "type": "string"
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "action",
            "request_id",
            "name"
          ],
          "type": "object"
        },
        {
          "description": "Start the app host again for an existing record.",
          "properties": {
            "action": {
              "const": "resume",
              "type": "string"
            },
            "name": {
              "description": "Orchestrator name.",
              "type": "string"
            },
            "request_id": {
              "description": "Home-assigned correlation id.",
              "type": "string"
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "action",
            "request_id",
            "name"
          ],
          "type": "object"
        }
      ]
    },
    "OrchestratorError": {
      "description": "A typed orchestrator failure.\n\n`message` and `detail` are redacted by the sender: neither carries a local path, a port,\na password, a pairing link or a secret value.",
      "properties": {
        "code": {
          "description": "Machine-readable code, for example `node_offline`, `refused` or `spawn_failed`.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "message": {
          "description": "Human-readable message; never a secret value or an absolute local path.",
          "type": "string"

        "retryable": {
          "description": "Whether retrying the same command may succeed.",

        }
      },
      "required": [
        "code",
        "message",
        "retryable"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    "OrchestratorNodeState": {
      "description": "Lifecycle state of an orchestrator.\n\nThe first three states are the v0.2 home states. The v0.4 local-node states add\n`node_offline` (the record exists but the node that runs the app is unreachable) and\n`failed` (the node refused or lost the app). `starting` covers the window between the\nhome sending a start command and the node accepting it.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "const": "starting",
          "description": "The home sent a start command and is waiting for the node's result.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "running",
          "description": "The app host is running.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "stopped",
          "description": "The app host was stopped by the owner.",
          "type": "string"

      "properties": {
        "code": {
          "description": "Machine-readable code, for example `not_found`, `refused` or `lease_revoked`.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "message": {
          "description": "Human-readable message; never a secret value or an absolute local path.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "retryable": {
          "description": "Whether retrying the same request may succeed.",
          "type": "boolean"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "code",
        "message",
        "retryable"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    "ToolResult": {
      "description": "Home -> agent: the result of one [`ToolCall`].\n\nExactly one of `result` and `error` is set. Neither an error nor a result carries a\nhome secret value or an absolute local path.",
      "properties": {
        "error": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "$ref": "#/$defs/ToolError"
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ],
          "description": "Typed failure, when the call failed."
        },
        "request_id": {
          "description": "Request id from the matching [`ToolCall`].",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "result": {
          "description": "Tool result as normal MCP JSON, when the call succeeded."
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "request_id"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    "TurnSummary": {
      "description": "The terminal summary an agent sends in [`AgentFrame::TurnEnd`].",
      "properties": {
        "cost": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/Cost",
          "description": "Cost and token usage reported by the harness."
        },
        "exit_code": {
          "description": "Process exit code, when the harness produced one.",
          "format": "int32",
          "type": [
            "integer",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "limit": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "$ref": "#/$defs/LimitEvent"
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ],
          "description": "Provider limit that ended the run, when one was classified."
        },
        "native_session_id": {
          "description": "Harness-side session id, when one was reported.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "outcome": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/RunOutcome",
          "description": "Classified run outcome."
        },
        "result_text": {
          "description": "Final assistant text, when any.",
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "stop_reason": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/StopReason",
          "description": "Why the run stopped."
        },
        "usage": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "$ref": "#/$defs/RemoteUsage"
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ],
          "description": "Resource usage measured on the agent, when available."
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "outcome",
        "cost",
        "stop_reason"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    "UsageSource": {
      "description": "Where a [`RunUsage`] row came from.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "const": "cgroup",
          "description": "Measured through a cgroup v2 scope.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "proc_tree",
          "description": "Measured by walking the process tree under `/proc`.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "const": "default",
          "description": "The compiled default because neither measurement was available.",
          "type": "string"
        }
      ]
    }
  },
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "description": "One agent protocol frame, tagged by `type`.",
  "oneOf": [
    {
      "description": "Agent -> home: identity and capabilities.",
      "properties": {
        "agent_version": {
          "description": "Agent binary version.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "arch": {
          "description": "CPU architecture.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "capabilities": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/AgentCapabilities",
          "description": "Names-only capabilities."
        },
        "key_id": {
          "description": "Public-key id.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "labels": {
          "description": "Owner-assigned labels.",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "node": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/NodeName",
          "description": "Node name."
        },
        "os": {
          "description": "Operating system name.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "type": {
          "const": "agent_hello",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type",
        "node",
        "key_id",
        "agent_version",
        "os",
        "arch",
        "labels",
        "capabilities"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Home -> agent: the nonce and limits for authentication.",
      "properties": {
        "connection_id": {
          "description": "Connection identity.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "heartbeat_secs": {
          "description": "Heartbeat interval in seconds.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "home_id": {
          "description": "Home identity.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "max_frame_bytes": {
          "description": "Maximum accepted frame size in bytes.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "nonce": {
          "description": "One-time nonce.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "server_time": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/Timestamp",
          "description": "Home server time."
        },
        "type": {
          "const": "home_challenge",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type",
        "nonce",
        "home_id",
        "connection_id",
        "server_time",
        "heartbeat_secs",
        "max_frame_bytes"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Agent -> home: signature over the challenge.",
      "properties": {
        "signature": {
          "description": "Lowercase hex signature.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "type": {
          "const": "agent_auth",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type",
        "signature"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Home -> agent: the handshake succeeded.",
      "properties": {
        "connection_id": {
          "description": "Connection identity.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "home_id": {
          "description": "Home identity.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "node": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/NodeName",
          "description": "Node name."
        },
        "protocol": {
          "description": "Negotiated protocol.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "type": {
          "const": "home_welcome",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type",
        "protocol",
        "home_id",
        "node",
        "connection_id"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Agent -> home: redeem a one-time enrollment code.",
      "properties": {
        "agent_version": {
          "description": "Agent binary version.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "arch": {
          "description": "CPU architecture.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "capabilities": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/AgentCapabilities",
          "description": "Names-only capabilities."
        },
        "code": {
          "description": "One-time enrollment code; never logged.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "labels": {
          "description": "Owner-assigned labels.",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "os": {
          "description": "Operating system name.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "paths": {
          "description": "Initial project path map.",
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/AgentPathMap"
          },
          "type": "array"
        },
        "public_key": {
          "description": "Lowercase hex ed25519 public key.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "type": {
          "const": "enroll",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type",
        "code",
        "public_key",
        "agent_version",
        "os",
        "arch",
        "labels",
        "capabilities",
        "paths"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Home -> agent: enrollment succeeded.",
      "properties": {
        "heartbeat_secs": {
          "description": "Heartbeat interval in seconds.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "home_id": {
          "description": "Home identity.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "node": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/NodeName",
          "description": "Node name."
        },
        "protocol": {
          "description": "Negotiated protocol.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "server_time": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/Timestamp",
          "description": "Home server time."
        },
        "type": {
          "const": "enrolled",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type",
        "home_id",
        "node",
        "protocol",
        "server_time",
        "heartbeat_secs"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Agent -> home: redeem a one-time pairing code for a local surface.",
      "properties": {
        "app": {
          "description": "Application name, for example `opencode`.",

        },

          "description": "One-time pairing code; never logged or echoed.",
          "type": "string"
        },

          "description": "Session the surface will mirror."
        },
        "surface_id": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/SurfaceId",
          "description": "Surface the owner created on the home."
        },
        "type": {
          "const": "surface_pair",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type",
        "code",
        "surface_id",
        "session",
        "app"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Home -> agent: the pairing succeeded and issued a token.",
      "properties": {
        "expires_at": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/Timestamp",
          "description": "When the token expires."
        },
        "scopes": {
          "description": "Scopes granted to the token.",

        },

          "description": "Secret token; write it 0600, never log or echo it.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "type": {
          "const": "surface_issued",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type",
        "surface_id",
        "token",
        "scopes",
        "expires_at"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Home -> agent: the surface token was revoked; detach and delete it.",

          "description": "Human-readable reason.",

        },

          "$ref": "#/$defs/SurfaceId",

        },
        "type": {
          "const": "surface_revoked",

        }
      },
      "required": [

        "surface_id",
        "reason"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/SurfaceAttach",

        }

        "type"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/SurfaceDetach",

        "type": {

        "type"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/SurfaceEvent",

      "properties": {
        "type": {
          "const": "surface_event",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/SurfaceTurn",

        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/ToolCall",

        }

      "required": [
        "type"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/ToolResult",

      "properties": {
        "type": {
          "const": "tool_result",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [

      ],

    {
      "description": "Agent -> home: acquire or take over the session lease.",

          "$ref": "#/$defs/SurfaceId",

      "required": [

        "session",
        "surface_token",
        "mode"
      ],

    },
    {
      "description": "Agent -> home: keep the held lease alive.",
      "properties": {
        "session": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/SessionId",

        "surface": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/SurfaceId",
          "description": "Surface holding the lease."
        },

          "description": "Plaintext lease token returned by `LeaseGrant`; never logged.",
          "type": "string"

        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type",
        "surface",
        "session",
        "token"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Agent -> home: release the lease on detach.",
      "properties": {

          "description": "Plaintext lease token returned by `LeaseGrant`; never logged.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "type": {
          "const": "lease_release",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type",
        "surface",
        "session",
        "token"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Home -> agent: the lease is granted for this surface.",

        "type": {

      ],

        },

        }
      },
      "required": [

        "kind",

      ],

    {

            {

        },

          "description": "Prompt for this turn.",

        },

        "surface",
        "session",
        "lease_token",
        "prompt",
        "executor",
        "cwd_ref",
        "purpose"

    },
    {
      "description": "Home -> agent: the turn started and the run id is assigned.",

        "expires_at": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/Timestamp",

        },

          "$ref": "#/$defs/RunId",

        },
        "session": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/SessionId",
          "description": "Session the run belongs to."
        },
        "tail_seq": {
          "description": "Last session sequence the agent may continue from.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "type": {
          "const": "turn_grant",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [

        "run_id",
        "session",
        "lease_token",
        "expires_at",
        "tail_seq"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Agent -> home: one v0.2 remote line wrapped with its run and epoch.",
      "properties": {
        "epoch": {
          "description": "Run epoch; a later frame with another epoch is fenced.",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0,
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "line": {
          "$ref": "#/$defs/RemoteLine",

          "$ref": "#/$defs/RunId",

        "type": {

        }
      },
      "required": [
        "type",
        "run_id",
        "epoch",
        "line"
      ],
      "type": "object"
    },
    {
      "description": "Home -> agent: the result of one remote line.\n\nExactly one of the optional fields is set for each acknowledgement kind:\n`event_id`/`seq` for an append or duplicate, `seq` for a summary,\n`lease_revoked` for a takeover and `error` for a rejection.",
      "properties": {
        "duplicate": {
          "description": "Whether the event was already present.",
          "type": "boolean"
        },
